name: AgingCar

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: Their current car is becoming unreliable

scenario_template.topic: Discussing whether they need a replacement car
scenario_template.note: They compare repair costs with the possibility of replacing the vehicle

scenario_template.topic: Realizing a replacement would require significant savings
scenario_template.note: They do not want to sacrifice other financial goals

scenario_template.topic: Setting a realistic car savings target
scenario_template.note: They ask how to incorporate the goal into their existing budget

scenario_template.topic: Comparing a down payment, purchase price, insurance, and maintenance
scenario_template.note: Assistant encourages them to consider total ownership costs

scenario_template.topic: Balancing car savings against other priorities
scenario_template.note: They discuss emergency savings and everyday expenses

scenario_template.topic: Adjusting the target if the purchase is delayed
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them turn delay into additional savings time

scenario_template.topic: Choosing a monthly amount for the car fund
scenario_template.note: They have a concrete timeline without rushing the purchase

scenario_template.topic: Running into an old mechanic friend

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
